text.en:
The provision of section sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Revised Administrative Code, as amended, relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Batangas, is further amended to read as follows:
"Batangas, four assistant provincial fiscals;"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 1, 1955.
